subject.title: fix(ios): attach EKAlarm to reminders.add so due-time notifications fire

question: Should every time-specific `reminders.add` `dueISO` implicitly create a Reminders notification, or should notification delivery require an explicit alarm input?
rationale: EventKit separates deadlines from alarms, while OpenClaw’s current command contract does not establish whether `dueISO` should imply both; choosing the default changes user-visible behavior for existing callers.

options.title: Make dueISO alerting
options.body: Define a time-specific `dueISO` as both the deadline and notification time, then require real iOS proof before merge.

options.title: Add explicit alarm input
options.body: Preserve deadline-only `dueISO` behavior and introduce a separately reviewed alarm field for callers requesting notifications.

recommendation.title: Make dueISO alerting
recommendation.body: Define a time-specific `dueISO` as both the deadline and notification time, then require real iOS proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository’s contributor guidance identifies this person as an iOS application contact, and the unresolved choice is a native product contract rather than a mechanical Swift question.
